evidence.ACL: The anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are unremarkable.
evidence.MCL: Mild thickening of the proximal fibers of the medial cruciate ligament, with mild edema, compatible with grade 1 sprain.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: without extension to the articular surface, compatible with intrasubstance degeneration. No frank tear.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: There is a complex degenerative tear of the lateral meniscus with partial maceration of the anterior horn and anterior body, as well as a longitudinal oblique component involving the posterior horn.
evidence.Medial OA: Moderate thinning of the articular cartilage of the weightbearing femur and tibia.
evidence.Lateral OA: Full-thickness fissures in the articular cartilage of the tibial weightbearing surface with associated subchondral bone marrow edema. There is moderate thinning of the articular cartilage of the weightbearing femur and of the tibial plateau.
evidence.PF OA: Multifocal deep and delaminating fissuring of the articular cartilage of the patellar facet without associated subchondral bone marrow edema. Additionally, there is moderate thinning of the articular cartilage of the femoral trochlea
evidence.Effusion: Small joint effusion with synovial thickening compatible with synovitis.
evidence.Synovitis: Small joint effusion with synovial thickening compatible with synovitis.
evidence.Baker's: There is popliteal cyst measuring 21 x 17 x 35 mm.
